name: AWS AI-Driven Development Lifecycle
description: A three-phase development lifecycle for AI-native software delivery, progressing from discovery through implementation to operations

phases.name: Inception
phases.description: Discovery and requirements definition phase. Establishes vision, requirements, technical design, and architecture.

deliverables.name: Vision Document
deliverables.description: Strategic vision and product direction defining problem space, target users, and success criteria

deliverables.name: Requirements Specification
deliverables.description: Detailed functional and non-functional requirements with acceptance criteria

deliverables.name: Technical Specification
deliverables.description: Technical design including APIs, data models, and system interfaces

deliverables.name: Architecture Specification
deliverables.description: System architecture including component design, scalability, and deployment topology

gates.name: Inception Review
gates.description: Human review and approval of all Inception phase documents before proceeding to Construction

phases.name: Construction
phases.description: Implementation planning and testing phase. Creates implementation plan, test plan, integration plan, and security review.

deliverables.name: Implementation Plan
deliverables.description: Detailed implementation plan with milestones, task breakdown, and resource allocation

deliverables.name: Test Plan
deliverables.description: Comprehensive test plan including test strategy, test cases, and automation approach

deliverables.name: Integration Plan
deliverables.description: Integration plan for connecting with external systems and services

deliverables.name: Security Review
deliverables.description: Security analysis including threat modeling, access control, and compliance requirements

gates.name: Construction Review
gates.description: Human review and approval of all Construction phase documents before proceeding to Operations

phases.name: Operations
phases.description: Deployment and operational readiness phase. Creates runbook, monitoring plan, disaster recovery plan, and SLO document.

deliverables.name: Runbook
deliverables.description: Operational runbook with deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and maintenance tasks

deliverables.name: Monitoring Plan
deliverables.description: Monitoring and observability plan with metrics, alerts, and dashboards

deliverables.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
deliverables.description: Disaster recovery plan with RTO/RPO targets, backup strategies, and failover procedures

deliverables.name: SLO Document
deliverables.description: Service Level Objectives with SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and reporting

gates.name: Operations Review
gates.description: Human review and approval of all Operations phase documents before production deployment

dependencies.description: Document dependencies define the workflow graph

costEstimates.description: Estimated LLM costs for full workflow (at Claude Sonnet pricing)

references.title: AWS Project Mantle
references.description: Case study of AIDLC at ASDM Level 5

relatedFrameworks.relationship: AIDLC is the methodology used at ASDM Level 4 (AI-Native Workflows)
